items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: The interviewee only responds to the interviewer's mention of 'Bunk' with 'Black Pete.' and does not provide any personal anecdote, relationship, or direct interaction with Bunk.

ctx.x: Fred Washington was in the tune. But see Fred was more uptown. Uptown, he played in the district too I know. Yeah, district.
There was another fellow that Bunk used to tell me about, that played with Big Eye in the district. They called him Black Pete. I don't know his real name. Black Pete.
